about_the_game:
Welcome to the demo of Off-World Prospecting, a game about delving into the soil and sediment of the mysterious colony world L 98-59 b. You will discover artifacts of a lost human age, and dig and mine while upgrading your gear, and earn your keep exporting your goods for sale. Prepare to investigate mysterious signals from detected beacons transmitting underground. Finding what they hold will be the key to learning more. You'll be able to dig into and transform the land as you progress!

In this demo, you'll be at on planet L 98-59 b. Your base is outfitted and ready for you to get to work. Your pre-fabricated BrightHope(TM) mobile prospecting outpost will be sufficient to supply you with needed survival resources. You'll upgrade your digging and mining tools, scanner, jetpack, and inventory with money you earn for materials you acquire.

Your outpost was built on top of the location thought to be an outpost of a previous age. You will dig and find any artifacts from that bygone era and of course, and mine for resources. Your planetary corporate superiors will happily compensate you for each artifact and of course pay you for the valuable items you mine. We hope you enjoy your time with Off-World Prospecting and come back for more!
